description.value:
Frequency at will

Attempt a Stealth check to Hide from your Marked quarry specifically, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus (+4 at Veteran, +6 at Undying) and ignoring the normal requirement for cover or concealment against it. On success you're undetected by that quarry alone; other creatures perceive you as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Has real, stated numbers and would be a clean FlatModifier on a Stealth check once the Mark predicate exists — currently blocked purely on that. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
